title: 해양수산부장관의 소속 청장 지휘에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00778:20251231:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 해양수산부장관의 소속 청장 지휘에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 778, December 31, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on January 1, 2026: Provided, That Article 2 of these Addenda shall enter into force on January 2, 2026.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) and (2) Omitted.

(3) Part of the Rules on Direction of the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard under the Jurisdiction of the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall be amended as follows:

In Article 3, "Ministry of Economy and Finance" shall be replaced with "Ministry of Planning and Budget".
